4.$description: Default small gap; stacked form fields.

5.$description: Component-internal (mixed-density add): button padding-x, input padding.

6.$description: Gap between components in a grid/row; card-grid gap.

12.$description: Small section rhythm; large intra-block spacing.

20.$description: Major vertical section rhythm (content-sparse marketing cadence).

page-gutter.$description: Horizontal padding on page-level containers → 32px (space-8). Snaps the site's ~30px gutter to the scale.

section-gap.$description: Vertical gap between major page sections → 80px (space-20). Reflects the content-sparse marketing rhythm (site uses ~84px).

component-gap.$description: Gap between adjacent components in a list/row → 24px (space-6). The standard card-grid gap.
